 Best of Negotiations: Daylian Cain 
 
 Best of Negotiations: Daylian Cain Aug 31, 2026

 This
week’s Summer Series is another two-fer, this time on
negotiations. The first is with legendary former FBI-hostage
negotiator Chris Voss, the author of Never Split the
Difference and founder of the Black Swan group where he
teaches tactical empathy in negotiations.  The second is with
Yale professor Daylian Cain, who opened my eyes to the
importance of walking
away.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
